name: Bvlgari Shanghai
insider_take: Where Italian luxury meets Shanghai's dynamic energy in a stunning riverside tower designed by Antonio Citterio.
whats_special: This architectural marvel rises 48 floors above the historic Bund, featuring Italy's legendary craftsmanship with panoramic views of the Huangpu River. The hotel showcases Bulgari's signature black marble and gold accents throughout, while its location in the former British Consulate area connects guests to Shanghai's rich trading history.
pro_tip: Book a Huangpu River-facing suite for sunrise views over the Oriental Pearl Tower, and time your arrival for golden hour when the Bund's colonial architecture glows against the modern Pudong skyline.
dont_miss: The rooftop Il Bar with 360-degree city views, authentic Italian dining at Il Ristorante, and a stroll along the adjacent Bund Promenade to witness the nightly light show across the river in Lujiazui financial district.
pros: Iconic Italian luxury design with signature Bvlgari elegance
Prime location in Shanghai's prestigious commercial district
Exceptional spa and wellness facilities with signature treatments
World-class dining venues featuring Italian and contemporary cuisine
cons: Ultra-luxury pricing reflects exclusive brand positioning
Limited availability due to boutique hotel size
